lesson.text: Lapar? Di **Unit 8** kamu belajar semua hal tentang **makanan dan minuman**: menyebut namanya, menghitung jumlahnya, dan **memesan** di kantin atau restoran dengan sopan.

lesson.title: 4. Countable dan uncountable
lesson.text:
Benda dalam bahasa Inggris ada dua jenis:
• **Countable** (bisa dihitung satu per satu): *an egg, two eggs, three apples*.
• **Uncountable** (tidak bisa dihitung satu per satu): *rice, water, milk, sugar, bread, meat*.

lesson.title: Menghitung benda uncountable
lesson.text: Pakai **wadah atau ukuran**: [[a glass of water]], [[a cup of tea]], [[a plate of rice]], [[a bowl of soup]], [[a piece of cake]], [[a bottle of milk]], [[a slice of bread]]. Wadahnya bisa dihitung: *two glasses of water*.

lesson.title: 5. A/an, some, dan any
table: [[I have some apples.]] / [[There is some milk.]]
[[I don't have any apples.]] / [[Is there any milk?]]

lesson.title: Pengecualian: tawaran dan permintaan
lesson.text: Dalam **tawaran** atau **permintaan** yang kita harapkan dijawab "ya", pakai **some**: [[Would you like some tea?]] dan [[Can I have some water?]]

lesson.title: 6. How many dan How much
table: [[How many eggs do you want?]] — Two.
[[How much milk do you drink?]] — A glass.
[[How much is the fried rice?]] — It's fifteen thousand rupiah.

lesson.title: 7. Memesan makanan dengan sopan
table: [[What would you like?]] / [[Can I help you?]]
[[I'd like a bowl of meatball soup, please.]] / [[Can I have a glass of orange juice?]]
[[How much is it?]] / [[How much is that?]]

lesson.title: I'd like = I would like
lesson.text: **I'd like** artinya "Saya mau" dan terdengar lebih sopan daripada *I want*. Di restoran atau kantin, pakai **I'd like** atau **Can I have ...?**

read.text:
Every morning, my family has breakfast at six thirty. My mother makes fried rice with eggs. My father drinks black coffee, but I don't like coffee. I drink a glass of milk.
My little sister doesn't eat rice. She eats two slices of bread with jam. We don't have any fruit today, so we eat some after school.

read.focus: Present simple dan would like untuk makanan
read.id:
Hari ini, Rani makan siang di kantin sekolah. Dia suka sayur dan nasi. Dia tidak suka makanan goreng, dan tidak minum soda.
Di meja kasir, dia berkata, "Saya mau sepiring nasi, sedikit sayur, dan segelas air, tolong." Penjual bertanya, "Apakah Anda mau telur juga?" Rani berkata, "Ya, tolong. Berapa harganya?" "Delapan ribu rupiah," kata penjual.

read.text:
Today, Rani eats lunch at the school canteen. She likes vegetables and rice. She doesn't like fried food, and she doesn't drink soda.
At the counter, she says, "I'd like a plate of rice, some vegetables, and a glass of water, please." The seller asks, "Would you like an egg too?" Rani says, "Yes, please. How much is it?" "It's eight thousand rupiah," says the seller.
read.title: A Healthy Lunch
